Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Hi Emma —

Great questions. Putting a short options summary below and attaching the evidence timeline you asked for. High-level thoughts: we typically separate the cost of provisioning/residency (credits or region premium) from the professional work required to collect and package attestation evidence. That makes procurement cleaner and matches how customers capitalize vs expense.

Options (short):
- Option A (Recurring credits + reduced onboarding): Data-sovereignty credits billed monthly at 12% uplift on base token rates for EU-residency nodes. One-time evidence package = $15k (covers SOC2 package + HSM attestation bundle). 12-month commit => 20% off the evidence fee (so $12k).
- Option B (One-time residency set-up + no recurring uplift): One-time residency activation fee = $45k (covers dedicated config, landing zone, KMS/HSM provisioning). Evidence package included for up to 2 attestation deliveries in year 1; subsequent deliveries billed at $4k each.
- Option C (Blended commit): 6-month minimum commit to EU capacity, credits at 8% uplift and $8k evidence onboarding. Best if you want smaller upfront.

Tradeoffs: Option A gives predictable lower monthly ops for teams that want to expense; Option B is capital-heavy but reduces ongoing unit economics. We can structure credits as a percentage uplift (preferred by Finance) or as a fixed per-GB residency surcharge if you want predictability by data size.

Ben — I put numbers in the attached pricing sheet (redwood_kms_hsm_pricing_v2.xlsx). Stephanie — can you confirm typical evidence delivery cadence for warranty items and whether we can shorten the standard 6-week pack to 3 weeks for a one-time rush?

Marcus

Emma —

Couple of pragmatic notes from commercial/finance:
1) If MedVera is evaluating > $250k ARR/year of consumption, we can convert Option A into a blended credit where the EU uplift drops to 6% after the first $200k in spend and we waive 50% of the evidence fee on the first delivery.
2) PO timing: procurement typically wants the evidence delivery milestones in the SOW to match invoice milestones. We can do 30% on signing, 40% on evidence bundle delivery, 30% on acceptance.
3) For accounting: if you need capitalizable spend, Option B's one-time activation fee maps cleanly to CapEx; Option A's recurring uplift maps to OpEx.

Happy to model both. Marcus — I added a 'finance-friendly' tab in the pricing workbook with the milestone invoice schedule and an amortization example.

Ben

Thanks Marcus + Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifying procurement requests before we share with Finance:
- Can you put Option A and Option B side-by-side in a 12-month TCO (we care about net spend vs. expected throughput).
- We will need an explicit clause that Redwood will provide evidence artifacts for regulatory inspections within 30 days of request (we can discuss reasonable scope limits).
- MedVera uses an internal PO system that requires net-30 billing. Are you able to accept net-30 on the evidence fee?

Also attached is our security questionnaire with a couple of additional asks around key custody (we manage our own HSM keys but will require attestations for Redwood-managed KMS config).

If you can get the TCO and contract language draft to me by EOD Monday we can fast-track procurement.

—Emma

Emma —

Appreciate the procurement checklist. Quick answers/commitments from Redwood: 

- TCO: attaching a 12-month side-by-side model (see pricing tab in the workbook Ben shared). I'll push a redline for two short clauses we recommend for the contract: (1) evidence-delivery SLA — Redwood will deliver requested evidence artifacts for audits within 30 calendar days for covered items in the SOW (exclusions: third-party vendor proofs where Redwood must request certs), and (2) key-custody attestation — Redwood will provide an HSM attestation confirming that customer keys remain under customer-managed policies when customers elect external key control; we will also support KMS logs export to an S3 bucket on a 30-day cadence as part of the residency bundle.

- Net-30: we can accept net-30 on the one-time evidence fee for deals that sign a 12-month commitment. Without a 12-month commit we require 50% upfront for the evidence SOW.

- Rush timeline: we can compress the standard 6-week evidence pack to 3 weeks for a one-time rush for an additional $3k admin fee (this covers weekend-proofing and expedited attestations).

If you’re comfortable, we can present Option A with the 12-month commit path that reduces the evidence fee to $12k and accepts net-30. Marcus/Ben — can you confirm the payment milestone language Ben suggested and I'll draft the two clauses for signature-ready inclusion in the MSA addendum.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
